notes: Batch b33: the perfect-game reward swept 0 / 10 / 30 / 50 / 100 / 200 / 300 / 1000 on b27's hist8 config at 50M with SNEK_PPO_ANNEAL_FRACTION 0.5, so every ramp (gamma 0.99->0.999, lambda 0.95->0.999, entropy 0.01->0.001) is final at 25M and the last 25M runs at the finals. SNEK_PERFECT_GAME_REWARD 300 for this arm; it replaces the last meal's food reward of 1 and nothing else in the reward changes (preset b2, step penalty 0.01, chase-safe 0.1 gate 75). Why: at gamma 0.999 a meal of delay costs ~1% of the win bonus, so W sets the urgency to finish relative to eating, and invariants.md 6 (W > 1/(1-gamma^k), 84-143 at gamma 0.999) says 100 is marginal and anything below fails -- yet b30 at gamma 1.0 reached 99.82, so the rule is under test for PPO with a step penalty. The win100 cell is the in-batch control and also the first run of b27's config at 50M; b27's hist8 cell at 100M is the reference.
